note: text = caption wording; say = what the TTS reads when pronunciation needs help. gapBefore = silence before a scene's first line; holdAfter = extra time after a line for the on-screen action to finish. All figures on screen are the demo school's data as the app computes it.

lines.text: A primary school runs on paper.
Registers to tick. Exercises to mark. Every score added up by hand.
Then, at the end of term, a report card written out for every child.
CAS runs your whole primary school, from KG 1 to Basic 6, in one place.
lines.say: {CAS} runs your whole primary school, from K.G. one to Basic six, in one place.

lines.text: The headteacher sees the school at a glance: pupils, classes and today's attendance.
Set it up once.
Each class and its class teacher,
the subjects each class takes,
the GES grading scale,
and how much each kind of assessment counts.
Every pupil has a full record:
admission details, NHIS number and blood group, and both parents' contacts.
lines.say: admission details, N.H.I.S. number and blood group, and both parents' contacts.

lines.text: Teachers clock in from their phones.
A photo, and a GPS check that they're really on school grounds.
The class register takes a few taps.
Mark everyone present, change the few who aren't, and save.
Exercises, tests and projects go in as they happen.
Type the marks straight in,
and CAS works out every pupil's class score, weighted the way you set it.
lines.say: and {CAS} works out every pupil's class score, weighted the way you set it.

lines.text: Totals, grades and positions follow for every subject.
At the end of term, each report card puts itself together:
every subject, and attendance for the term.
Rate the pupil's conduct,
add your remark,
and submit it to the headteacher.
The headteacher follows every class's progress,
adds a remark, and approves, or sends it back with a reason.
Every clock-in reaches the office, GPS-verified.
Leave requests come in for approval too.
The Capitation Grant cash book records every receipt and payment,
by GES expenditure head,
with the balance always up to date.
And at the end of the year, promote every class and graduate Basic 6 in one step.
CAS. Comprehensive Academic Suite.
Your whole primary school, in one place.
Call LatexTech on 024 8234 649 for a free walkthrough.
lines.say: Call Latex Tech on, zero two four, eight two three four, six four nine, for a free walkthrough.
